method.bootstrapTest: tests/startup-index.test.mjs · browser bootstrap hydrates without a source scan and stays within its CPU budget
method.acceptance: Unchanged existing test and 1500 ms limit. Every predeclared attempt is retained; any failed attempt exits nonzero. No retries until pass.
method.warmSetup: The existing test imports index/story modules and evaluates catalog/reference scripts before its timer. A fresh process is not a claim of fully cold source compilation.
method.timing: Elapsed values are wall time. CPU diagnostics use process-wide user+system microseconds and may exceed wall time with multiple process threads.
method.vmOverhead: The unchanged gate runs each source separately with timeout watchdogs. --profile also measures a separate single-call built-inline-script prefix; it does not replace the gate.
method.limits: Node/V8 proxy only. Source strings are read before the budget timer. Excludes disk/network delivery, HTML/CSS parsing, layout, paint, storage restoration, main-view rendering, native MathML, physical phone/touch and assistive technology. OS caches are not flushed.

artifact.compressionNote: Local gzip estimate, not evidence of production transfer headers or size.

production.scope: Built concatenated inline script prefix through header search, before storage and main-view mounting; Node/V8 diagnostic, not the acceptance gate or browser qualification.
